designationHistory.name: Columbia River Islands Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: The Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approved purchase of 3,110 acres and a county management agreement, about 8,100 acres in all, for a refuge in the Columbia River estuary, first called the Columbia River Islands Refuge.

authority.citation: Migratory Bird Conservation Commission approval (Migratory Bird Conservation Act)

designationHistory.note: FWS CCP: acquisition boundary identified January 5, 1971; MBCC approval September 21, 1971; 25-year management agreement with Clatsop County April 19, 1972. Which of these counts as establishment is not stated; the MBCC approval is used here.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Lewis and Clark NWR and Julia Butler Hansen Refuge CCP/EIS (2010), sec. 1.6.1
